# Question 1: Import and Summarize the Data

Your code:

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(Rmisc)
library(summarytools)
library(psych)

filepath <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/craigenders/psych250a/main/data/assignment4.csv"

assign4 <- read.csv(filepath, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

dfSummary(assign4)

describe(assign4)
```

# Question 2: Convert Female to a Factor

Your code: 

```{r}
assign4$Female <- factor(assign4$Female,
                           levels = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("Male", "Female"))

freq(assign4$Female)
```

# Question 3: 95% Confidence Interval for Perceived Discrimination

Your code:

```{r}
CI(assign4$Discrim, ci = 0.95)
```

# Question 8: Confidence Intervals by Sex

Your code:

```{r}
group.CI(Discrim ~ Female, data = assign4, ci = 0.95)

ggplot(assign4, aes(x = Female, y = Discrim)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "pointrange")
```
